orgDesign.companyProfile: Proposed scale-up operating model for a specialist B2B video intelligence platform. Six teams total 36 delivery FTE plus two shared leadership roles. This is not reported Media Distillery staffing; commercial sales, finance and legal services are outside these delivery totals.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Product teams own viewer outcomes; Video Understanding owns shared source/model quality; Platform owns trust and continuity; Solutions owns accepted integrations and recurring value. Every brick has one primary owner via brickDependencies. Small teams require shared incident rotation, managed infrastructure and phased event/language coverage. Two group-direct roles provide product and engineering direction; no separate management layer per feature.
